title: A hidden gold stash was granted silently — no '(+N gold)' tag in the action result the way score/xp gains always get one. I only learned money had changed hands afterward via a follow-up 'look' that mentioned 'the coin someone hid there is gone.'
where: Cracked Adit, the Iron Downs / 'work the already-loosened corner' (3rd attempt, nat 20)
